Class PasskeyUserEntityRepository

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.security.passkey.PasskeyUserEntityRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.security.web.webauthn.management.PublicKeyCredentialUserEntityRepository
@Component public class PasskeyUserEntityRepository extends Object implements org.springframework.security.web.webauthn.management.PublicKeyCredentialUserEntityRepository
Maps the WebAuthn user entity onto the user table: name is the e-mail address, display name the nickname, id the user handle in user.passkey_user_handle. findByUsername(String) returns an entity for every existing user and creates the handle on first use, so the relying party operations never fall back to an entity of their own, which would carry the e-mail address as display name. The handle stays for the life of the user, also after the last passkey was deleted.
